title: CONNECT-IP ADDRESS_REQUEST Capsule Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for RFC 9484 ADDRESS_REQUEST capsule behavior.
scope: This verification covers ADDRESS_REQUEST send policy, unprompted ADDRESS_ASSIGN permission, Type 0x02 and length encoding, Requested Address field order and one-or-more requirement, IP address/version/prefix field validation, Request ID varint/non-zero/unique rules, malformed field handling, assignment response matching and values, unassigned zero-address responses, rejected-address exclusion, and empty-request stream abort policy.
preconditions: RFC 9484 ADDRESS_ASSIGN capsule support is implemented.
expected_result: The focused ADDRESS_REQUEST tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9484 ADDRESS_REQUEST artifacts, generated triage reflects requirements 0100-0126 as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The RFC 9484 ADDRESS_REQUEST capsule surface is trace-owned and verified by focused local gates.
